permit.applies: The applicant, by letter to the Chief Director of Immigration with the residence permit form (I.F.5) and the temporary employment form, in duplicate; the employer's company documents go with it.
permit.first: A contract of employment, an advertisement of the post in a local newspaper, the CVs of shortlisted candidates and of the persons identified to understudy, and clearance by the relevant authorities for professionals.

sources.title: Department of Immigration Zimbabwe, Fees
sources.said: CLIENT SERVICE COST($USD) Temporary employment permit applicants Ordinary 500 USD Short term permit 500 USD Temporary employment permit extensions Ordinary 500 USD

sources.title: Department of Immigration Zimbabwe, Permits
sources.said: Temporary Employment Permit Requirements Residence permit application form (I.F.5) fully completed. Temporary Employment application form. Application letter addressed to the Chief Director of Immigration (CDI). … Contract of employment. … Advertisement in local newspaper. CV for shortlisted candidates including their contact details. CV and qualifications of persons identified to do understudy. … Temporary Employment Permit Extension Application letter addressed to the CDI requesting for extension. … Professionals to be cleared by relevant authorities.

sources.title: Immigration Act [Chapter 4:02] (Department of Immigration Zimbabwe), s. 19
sources.said: shall provide for students permits, temporary employment permits and temporary permits;
